description: Startup exit / liquidation preference waterfall — Who gets what in an acquisition: pays debt and fees, then liquidation preferences (pari passu or stacked seniority), lets each non-participating preferred class convert to common when that pays more, handles participating preferred with caps, and returns payout, per-share value and MOIC per class plus common, the amount below which common gets nothing, and a 0.25x-4x exit sensitivity table. Params: exit ($), common (shares), classes (name:invested:shares[:multiple][:n|p][:cap] separated by ;, most senior first); optional seniority (pari|stacked), debt, fees (%). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_exit_waterfall
